entries.description: PLANNED, not yet observed: the 2016-Q1 descriptive diagnostic (one governed run: SIP minute-bar acquisition plus the seven-candidate screen, one P3A attempt). A counts-and-timestamps-only availability probe on 2026-10-12 requested bars for a few 2016 dates (2016-01-05 among them) and read no price or volume value; it is disclosed here and is not result exposure. Actual exposure is recorded in the successor ledger after the run.
